propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has been the Senior Treasury Operations Analyst at a regional bank for three years, the senior analyst of record signing the daily liquidity pack, after two years as an associate analyst preparing the same pack.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the signed pack document the senior analyst role and the years.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has been a Certified Treasury Professional since 2023 and supervised the two associate analysts who prepared the daily pack through their preparation checklist and the four-eyes review.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the certificate document the certification and the supervision.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate reconciled the regulatory liquidity returns with finance monthly under the bank's reconciliation procedure and wrote the daily pack's boundary note and open items list for the treasurer.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the workbook document the reconciliation and the boundary note.

expectedGap: None; the materials document the senior analyst role, the certification, the supervision, the reconciliation and the boundary notes.
expectedBoundaryNote: The senior analyst role and the certification are documented in the resume, the signed pack and the certificate; the associate years are shown separately.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the certification number so the association's registry entry can be checked.
